text:
maya singh: Heads-up 10: I'm testing a compact breadcrumb pattern for deep-linked pages. Problem: long workspace/model paths blow out the header. Proposal: show a collapsed middle crumb with an ellipsis button that expands on click or keyboard. Also add a small 'source pill' when arriving from external deep links (docs/ticket). Thoughts?

jun park: BTW we should preserve query/hash when resolving legacy permalinks. Users expect ?tab and #anchor to remain.

elaine wu: UI nits: the collapsed crumb should have an accessible name like "Show path" and the expand button must be reachable via keyboard. If expanded state opens a menu, it should be role="menu" and trap focus correctly.

samir (sam): agree. aria: the ellipsis button should have aria-expanded and an aria-controls pointing at the expanded list. Also announce expansion in an aria-live region: "Navigation path expanded". For deep link source pill use aria-hidden on the visual-only icon but expose the full text to screen readers (e.g., "Arrived from: docs").

mike cole: routing note: we'll implement a middleware that maps legacy anchors. For example: 
```n// server middleware
legacyRoutes = [ {from: '/models/:id', to: '/ws/:wsId/serving/models/:id'}, ... ]
// preserve query/hash: redirect to `${to}${req.url.search}${req.url.hash}`
```n
We can emit a nav_source=deeplink query param only for telemetry (not permanent) so link sharing isn't polluted. We'll also add a Redirect header X-Original-Path for debugging.

jun park: Behavior question: when arriving via deep-link and expanding the breadcrumb, should the browser history get a new entry? I prefer not — expand/collapse is UI state, shouldn't create history noise. Use replaceState if we change the pathname to canonicalize.

maya singh: good point. We shouldn't create history entries for nav UI. Also UX: show a short hint the first time a user sees collapsed crumbs: "Press / to jump to nav". But keep ephemeral.

elaine wu: copy suggestions: pill copy: "From docs" or "From support ticket" not "Arrived from docs" (shorter). Tooltip: "Expand full path (/org/xxx/workspaces/... )". Collapse control ARIA: "Collapse navigation" vs "Hide navigation"? we should be consistent with other controls.

samir (sam): consistency note: use "Hide navigation" where it actually hides the sidebar, use "Collapse path" for breadcrumb-specific control. Also add focus management acceptance: when deep link opens a details flyout, focus goes to flyout heading and pressing Escape returns focus to the breadcrumb or the element that triggered the deep link.

mike cole: infra: I'll add a small redirect table entry and a router-shim that does the canonical path rewrite + telemetry. Ticket -> PLAT-4001. We'll ensure the shim sets history.replaceState and retains hash+search.

jun park: analytics: include a one-off event deeplink_opened with properties: origin (docs|ticket|external), legacy=true/false, preserved_fragment=true/false. That will help gauge how many legacy rewrites happen.

maya singh: accessibility testcases: 1) tab to ellipsis, press Enter -> expanded menu opens and first item receives focus 2) screen reader reads source pill on arrival 3) expanding doesn't break skiplinks. Sam will own.

samir (sam): yep I'll add those to the sprint tests. Also request: give me the aria-label values before implementation so I can sanity-check читаемость for SRs.

elaine wu: small behavior tweak: if a deep link points to a nested panel (eg, /models/:id?openPanel=weights), show the compact breadcrumb and an unobtrusive 'Open details' CTA on the header rather than auto-opening the full panel. That prevents focus traps for keyboard users.

jun park: agreed. Add a tiny animation delay for non-auto opens so page doesn't feel jumpy.

mike cole: noted. PLAT-4001 will list keep-hash requirement, replaceState behavior, X-Original-Path header, and telemetry payload.

maya singh: final checklist from design: microcopy for pill and tooltip (elaine), ellipsis button aria labels (sam), prototype update with expand animation (jun), docs sync about legacy links (priya? not in thread but tag later). I'll upload revised frames tomorrow.

jun park: thanks Maya. tagging priya in the design doc for docs sync. Anything else?

elaine wu: release note blurb: "Improved console breadcrumbs: long paths now collapse into a compact crumb; legacy links continue to work." short and friendly.

samir (sam): I'll add accessibility criteria to the PR checklist.

mike cole: filing ticket now -> https://tickets.redwood/PLAT-4001

maya singh: great, thanks all. I'll post the prototype link once frames are uploaded. :sparkles:
